**What to Expect**

Tesla's Vehicle Engineering department is composed of thousands of the world's best vehicle, battery, and manufacturing engineers. These engineers are responsible for the mechanical and industrial design of all major programs, for example, batteries, Optimus, Robotaxi, and all new factories. Design Technology, which is part of Vehicle Engineering, is responsible for making the tools these engineers use every bit as intelligent and dynamic as the products themselves.

As a PLM Quality & Support Engineer on the Design Technology team, you will own the accuracy of the Engineering BOM in and outside our PLM systems. Teams across Tesla depend on that data every day, from the design engineers creating our next products to the factory line itself. When something looks wrong, you decide whether it's a system defect or user error, find the root cause, and make sure it doesn't happen again.

Joining our team means directly impacting Tesla's ability to communicate critical design data as the company scales to ship millions of products a year from factories around the world.

 **What You'll Do**

* Validate EBOM and file data against the design intent in our PLM systems of record. Catch errors before they reach suppliers and factory lines

* Hands-on experience with a PLM system (3DEXPERIENCE/Enovia, Teamcenter, Windchill, or equivalent) in an engineering or manufacturing setting

We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

#### **Job Summary**

The Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF) enables a wide range of time-domain astronomy through large-scale astronomical data processing and the distribution of more than half a million transient alerts each night. The next phase of this work will integrate ZTF and upcoming Rubin Observatory data streams and develop tools that allow scientists to build, test, and manage complex alert filters through accessible graph-based interfaces. The Associate Research Technician will contribute to the development and testing of these tools, including integration with SkyPortal and public alert brokers. This is a one-year term appointment expected to start in October 2026.

* Work with scientists to define requirements, troubleshoot moderately complex technical issues, test solutions, and improve system capabilities and user experience.

* Experience using Git/GitHub and collaborative software-development workflows.
* Demonstrated programming experience in Python and JavaScript.
* Experience working with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
* Experience developing and testing user-facing software, including UI/UX design principles.
* Experience with a modern front-end framework such as React.

* Experience or demonstrated interest in astronomy, astronomical data systems, or scientific software development.

jobs.title: Research Associate, Cell Line Development Automation
jobs.description:
Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first-of-its-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV.

We are seeking a motivated Research Associate II or Senior Research Associate to join our Automation/Cell Line Development (CLD) team, with a focus on laboratory automation and high-throughput workflows. In this role, you will develop and optimize automated workflows to support cell line development, contribute to pipeline projects, and conduct experiments to improve the performance of our optogenetic Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cell lines. You will work at the intersection of laboratory automation, cell culture, and molecular biology, helping improve the efficiency, scalability, and reproducibility of our CLD processes. This role is based on-site at our headquarters in Emeryville, CA.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct experiments independently, collect and analyze data in a timely manner, and maintain detailed documentation in electronic lab notebooks.
* Conduct experiments at the Automation/CLD interface and establish efficient automation workflows (Tecan or Hamilton) for CLD processes during seed train, production, or screening (Ambr or Beacon) processes.
* Communicate successfully with any team, demonstrating the ability to compile and present across different teams and forums within the company.
* Quickly analyze and provide critical data and figures to support presentations, patent applications, or publications.
* Collaborate closely with members of the CLD team as well as other teams within Prolific Machines. Contribute to lab maintenance and safety as a good lab citizen.
* Develop and optimize analytical methods, ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards, following established protocols, and providing data for regulatory submissions.
* This is a lab-based position, and onsite presence is required as dictated by Automation and Cell Line Development (CLD) responsibilities and experimental needs.

### **About You:**

**Qualifications:**

* **Education & Experience**: A Bachelor's degree with 2-5+ years of relevant industry experience or a Master's degree with 1-4+ years of relevant experience is expected for an RA II position. Additional experience and increased independence expected at the Sr. RA level.
* **Designing and Executing Experiments**: Developing and proposing experimental plans, conducting experiments, and troubleshooting analytical techniques and methodologies
* **Work Style**: The candidate is expected to precisely follow protocols, design and execute experiments independently, and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.
* **Communication Skills**: Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for documenting findings and effective collaboration. Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) software and ability to perform independent data analysis and generating meaningful conclusions is required.

RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. Every solar and wind power plant is a latent data center. Rune connects wasted power to the compute that needs it. Rune deploys hardware, software, and financial solutions to put this power to work. **About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Control Technician to support product quality throughout the manufacturing and receiving processes. This role will be responsible for performing final inspection and testing, verifying the accuracy and completeness of product travelers and manufacturing documentation, conducting incoming and receiving inspections, and supporting inventory audits.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform functional, dimensional, and visual inspections against specs, drawings, and acceptance criteria, and document the results
* Verify finished products meet requirements before release or shipment
* Keep measuring and test equipment calibrated and in good working condition

**2. Product Travelers and Manufacturing Documentation**

* Resolve missing information or process deviations with the responsible teams before product release
* Keep quality records organized and easy to retrieve

**3. Incoming and Receiving Inspection**

* Inspect incoming materials and parts against POs, drawings, specs, and certifications (part numbers, revisions, quantities)
* Report discrepancies and damaged or nonconforming material, and work with Purchasing and the Warehouse on disposition
* Track recurring supplier issues and trends

**4. Inventory Audits and Traceability**

* Run periodic audits to verify part identification, quantities, condition, and lot/serial traceability
* Reconcile physical inventory to system records and investigate discrepancies
* Flag expired, damaged, or improperly identified material for resolution

**5. Quality Reporting, Excel, and KPI Tracking**

* Build and maintain Excel reports and dashboards covering pass/fail rates, nonconformance trends, incoming quality, and documentation completion
* Deliver routine status reports on inspections, open quality issues, and product readiness
* Analyze data to spot recurring issues and communicate findings to management

**6. Nonconformance and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming product, and support investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns
* Help improve inspection procedures, checklists, and work instructions

* Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), failure analysis, or other quality engineering tools.

new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Mountain View, CA

**About Rune:**

Every solar and wind power plant is a latent data center. Rune connects wasted power to the compute that needs it. Solar plants generate electricity the grid can't take: clipped by inverters, curtailed by operators, gone before it ever reaches a meter. Meanwhile, AI needs more power than new construction can deliver in time.

Rune deploys hardware, software, and financial solutions to put this power to work. We build modular micro data centers that install directly at solar sites, bypassing the traditional grid entirely and turning stranded power into compute. We're backed by Spark Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Lowercarbon Capital.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Control Technician to support product quality throughout the manufacturing and receiving processes. This role will be responsible for performing final inspection and testing, verifying the accuracy and completeness of product travelers and manufacturing documentation, conducting incoming and receiving inspections, and supporting inventory audits.

You’ll be the last line of defense on product quality, covering inspection and testing, documentation checks, and receiving. You’ll also own the reporting that shows how quality is trending. This is a growth role: the right person can move into Quality Engineering as we scale.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Final Inspection and Product Testing**

* Perform functional, dimensional, and visual inspections against specs, drawings, and acceptance criteria, and document the results
* Verify finished products meet requirements before release or shipment
* Keep measuring and test equipment calibrated and in good working condition

**2. Product Travelers and Manufacturing Documentation**

* Review travelers, work orders, and inspection records for completeness, accuracy, and proper sign-off sequence
* Resolve missing information or process deviations with the responsible teams before product release
* Keep quality records organized and easy to retrieve

**3. Incoming and Receiving Inspection**

* Inspect incoming materials and parts against POs, drawings, specs, and certifications (part numbers, revisions, quantities)
* Report discrepancies and damaged or nonconforming material, and work with Purchasing and the Warehouse on disposition
* Track recurring supplier issues and trends

**4. Inventory Audits and Traceability**

* Run periodic audits to verify part identification, quantities, condition, and lot/serial traceability
* Reconcile physical inventory to system records and investigate discrepancies
* Flag expired, damaged, or improperly identified material for resolution

**5. Quality Reporting, Excel, and KPI Tracking**

* Build and maintain Excel reports and dashboards covering pass/fail rates, nonconformance trends, incoming quality, and documentation completion
* Deliver routine status reports on inspections, open quality issues, and product readiness
* Analyze data to spot recurring issues and communicate findings to management

**6. Nonconformance and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming product, and support investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns
* Help improve inspection procedures, checklists, and work instructions

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training, an associate degree, or relevant coursework in quality, manufacturing, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in quality control, manufacturing inspection, receiving inspection, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel including the ability to organize, analyze, and present data and generate status reports and KPI summaries.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies in products, processes, and documentation.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection criteria.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple inspection and documentation priorities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with dimensional inspection tools, measurement equipment, and functional test equipment.
* Familiarity with manufacturing documentation, product travelers, inspection plans, and product traceability.
* Experience with ERP, inventory management, or quality management systems.
* Familiarity with quality management standards such as ISO 9001 or other applicable industry standards.
* Exposure to nonconformance reporting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, lookup functions, charts, conditional formatting, and data visualization.
* Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), failure analysis, or other quality engineering tools.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**  
Excelling in inspection, documentation, receiving, and reporting. As you prove out, take on root cause analysis, process improvement, and quality systems you can work on the path to Quality Engineer. This position is intended for someone who wants to build a long-term career in quality. We are looking for someone who can perform today's quality control responsibilities reliably while demonstrating the curiosity, analytical thinking, and initiative to help improve our quality processes for the future.
